note: The DDC/CI (MCCS) codes SYNQ may write, shared by src/lib/displays/vcp.ts and src-tauri/src/monitors.rs. continuous: 0..the maximum the monitor reports. listed: one of the values the monitor's capabilities string lists. Everything else is never written: the factory and restore codes (0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x08, 0x0A, 0x0C), power mode 0xD6, manufacturer codes 0xE0-0xFF and anything unknown.
